newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar touch weaker but holds strength.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar touch weaker but holds strength.

text.p: White sugar futures saw another thin start on Tuesday with the background of Russian buying keeping nearby prices steady at the recent higher levels, traders said.
"The buyers aren't in too much of a hurry to pay up and they're sitting there trying to pick away at it but the Russian interest is keeping the market on the boil," said one.
On the downside, some producer pricing in London is also thought to be keeping a lid on the market.
At 1125 GMT August was down 40 cents at $318.00 and October was untraded. Volume was a paltry 53 lots, most of which came from an August trade house sale to a commission house.
